ViewObject.Name: AgendaReservations
ViewObject.SQLQuery:
select
RESERVATION.BUSINESS_CASE_ID , RESERVATION.id , RESERVATION.created_date , RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id , PAR_POLICE.PAR_YEAR || '/' || PAR_POLICE.POLICE_NUMBER || '/' || CAS_TYPE.NAME|| '/' || POLICE.ENTITY_NAME BUSINESS_CASE_NUMBER , RESERVATION.CIRCLE_HEARING_DATE_ID ,circle.HEARING_DATE, RES_PARTIES.party_id , parties.PARTY_FULL_NAME , RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED, RES_PARTIES.ATTENDANCE , folder_data.JUDGMENT_TEXT ,
DECODE (RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id ,1, 'أول درجة' , 2 , 'معارضة' , 3 ,'إستئناف' ,4 ,'معارضة إستئنافية') Degree_Name ,
(select COURT_CIRCLES_DATES_HEARING.HEARING_DATE from COURT_CIRCLES_DATES_HEARING inner join COURT_BC_HEARING_RESERVATION on COURT_CIRCLES_DATES_HEARING.id = COURT_BC_HEARING_RESERVATION.circle_hearing_date_id
where COURT_BC_HEARING_RESERVATION.id in (select max ( COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_id ) from COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES where COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.party_id = RES_PARTIES.party_id and ( (RES_PARTIES.ATTENDANCE is not null and RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED = 0 and COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id = RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id+1 ) or (RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED = 1 and COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id = 1))
)) next_reservation_date
, (select EXC_FOLDER_PROCEDURES.PROCEDURE_DATE from EXC_FOLDER_PROCEDURES where id in( ( select max (EXC_FOLDER_actions.PROCEDURE_ID ) from EXC_FOLDER_actions where EXC_FOLDER_actions.folder_record_id in ( select exc_folder_data.id from exc_folder_data inner join COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES on exc_folder_data.RES_PARTY_ID = COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.id where COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id = RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id-1 and COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.ATTENDANCE is not null and COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED = 0 and COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES.party_id = RES_PARTIES.party_id )
and EXC_FOLDER_actions.action_type in (1,2,3,8,9,24)
)) )last_action
from
COURT_BC_HEARING_RESERVATION RESERVATION inner join COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES RES_PARTIES on RESERVATION.id = RES_PARTIES.COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_id inner join COURT_CIRCLES_DATES_HEARING circle on circle.id = RESERVATION.CIRCLE_HEARING_DATE_ID INNER join par_parties parties on parties.id = RES_PARTIES.PARTY_ID
inner join PAR_POLICE_AUTHORITY_REPORT PAR_POLICE on PAR_POLICE.BUSINESS_CASE_ID = RESERVATION.BUSINESS_CASE_ID inner join BUSINESS_CASE_TYPE CAS_TYPE on CAS_TYPE.id = PAR_POLICE.BUSINESS_CASE_TYPE inner join entity POLICE on POLICE.id = PAR_POLICE.ORIGIN_ENTITY INNER join par_parties parties on parties.id = RES_PARTIES.PARTY_ID
inner join COURT_CIRCLES_DATES_HEARING cou on cou.id = RESERVATION.CIRCLE_HEARING_DATE_ID inner join COURT_CIRCLES_DATES_HEARING cc on cou.HEARING_DATE = cc.HEARING_DATE and COU.ENTITY_ID = cc.ENTITY_ID
left outer join exc_folder_data folder_data on folder_data.RES_PARTY_ID = RES_PARTIES.id
where cc.id= :AgendaDateId
-- delay and (:postpon = 99 or RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED = :postpon )
-- with judge and ( :judg = 99 or ( RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED = 0 and RES_PARTIES.ATTENDANCE is not null ))
-- without judge and ( :nojudg = 99 or ( RES_PARTIES.POSTPONED = 0 and RES_PARTIES.ATTENDANCE is null ))
and ( :pDeg = 99 or (RES_PARTIES.bc_degree_spec_id = :pDeg )) and (:fold = 99 or folder_data.FOLDER_TYPE = :fold) order by RESERVATION.BUSINESS_CASE_ID desc
